content.summary: The framing distinguishes the conditional finite exclusion from a proved extremal bound, and separates mathematical proofs from partial formalization. Inspected theorem interfaces support the claimed support inequality and Fin 72 reduction. One formal-assurance claim lacks admissible evidence in this snapshot.
required_revisions: Supply the actual FrontierPairSix.common_point_of_incidence_defect source and matching successful compiler/axiom receipt, or qualify its fully elaborated status as unverified in the supplied evidence.

findings.statement: The six-codegree section calls common_point_of_incidence_defect fully elaborated, but the snapshot contains neither its source nor its compilation receipt; E01/E05 and the E18 manifest do not cover that declaration.
findings.disposition: Add source-bound evidence or qualify this assurance claim; the elementary argument itself is plausible.

checks.scope: Frozen bytes and quantified support inequality
checks.method: Recomputed the canonical snapshot digest and manuscript byte digest; inspected E01 theorem hypotheses and natural-number conclusion.
checks.observation: Both hashes match. The family is a Finset of Finsets, so duplicate members are excluded. Intersection includes self-pairs; consequently rank zero forces the family empty, resolving the difference between natural r-1 and displayed integer subtraction. No sunflower hypothesis occurs in the general inequality.

checks.method: Read the E01 exact-size subset and relabeling proof and compared its printed roots with E02.
checks.observation: A counterexample supplies 28 members, hereditary assumptions survive restriction, and support relabeling supplies Fin 72. The reverse direction applies the upper-bound assertion to that finite family. This proves an equivalence without proving obstruction nonexistence. E02 reports exit zero and only the stated foundational axioms for these roots, subject to retained-object trust.

checks.method: Compared E05 three_star_second_moment parameters and integer conclusion with Theorem 2.
checks.observation: Pairwise distinct selected points, uniformity, reflexive intersection, and signed pair/triple codegree correction match; selected points need not belong to support. The manuscript makes no unsupported full support-56 Lean claim.
